children: will host an Innovation Day webcast on September 17, 2026. The event will begin promptly at 9:00 am ET and conclude by 11:00 am ET. Ashland leadership will provide an updated overview of the company’s innovative Technology Platforms, highlighting their commercial progress and scalability. Registration is required, and participants are encouraged to join early. Registration can be accessed from the following link:

During the event, participants will hear from Ashland executives and senior technology leaders as they provide an in-depth review of the latest innovations and expanding commercial opportunities. The presentations will detail how these advancements are poised to impact key markets and drive organic growth.
Following the formal remarks, participants will have the opportunity to engage directly in a moderated question-and-answer (Q&A) session.
Ashland leaders presenting at the event include:
, senior vice president and chief technology officer
, senior vice president and general manager, personal care
, senior vice president and general manager, life sciences and intermediates
, senior vice president and general manager, specialty additives
, senior vice president and chief financial officer
Registration information and further event details can be found on Ashland’s investor website at

A webcast of the event will be available live and can be accessed, along with supporting materials, through the Ashland website. A replay will be available within 24 hours of the live event and will be archived, along with supporting materials, on the Ashland website for 12 months.
